$note: The house look and timing. The pipeline reads frame and voice; every scene reads the rest through timeline.json (src/scenes/house/kit.tsx useStyle), never this file. Colours are addressed by role name (color="accent"), so a palette change is an edit here and nowhere else. A film may override any key in films/<name>/style/tokens.json; KIT_TOKENS_OVERRIDE=<file> overrides both. style/house.md describes the look in words.

color.$note: Greyscale ink on warm paper and one accent. paper: the ground; ink: lines and type that matter; muted: labels and things that have stepped back; faint: guides, rules, the not-yet; accent: kept for the one idea that matters most in a scene; accentWash: the accent's tint, for fills and waiting time.

font.$note: System fonts on macOS, with fallbacks. serif: titles and the occasional phrase; sans: labels and cards; mono: code, file names, small print.

type.$note: Sizes in pixels of the square 1080 frame (kit.tsx scales nothing: a film with another frame sets its own).

line.$note: Stroke widths: stroke for drawing, hairline for guides and arrowheads, bold for the accent's marks.

ground.$note: The paper ground under every scene. grid is the spacing of a faint graph grid in pixels; 0 is plain paper (the house look).

voice.$pace: The speech check fails a line outside 2 to maxWps words/s (looping or truncation). A line just over is slowed toward targetWps by at most maxStretch. 4.3 suits the house voice at tempo 1.1.
